details: Bitcoin (BTC) is currently attempting a recovery, trading around $64,772 and challenging the key resistance level of $64,500. While technical indicators suggest a potential for further gains, on-chain signals remain mixed, with a noted decline in Bitcoin held in ETFs and some major buyers realizing losses. Despite recent volatility and some bearish on-chain indicators, Standard Chartered has reiterated its projection for Bitcoin to reach $100,000 by the end of 2026.
title: Bitcoin Attempts Recovery Amid Mixed Signals; Standard Chartered Maintains $100K Forecast

details: Ethereum (ETH) is trading at a critical juncture around $1,865.94, hovering near its daily pivot point of $1,866.93. This price level is significant, as a sustained move above it could signal a continuation of recovery, while a failure to hold could lead to a retest of support around $1,842.15. Both Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced slight dips over the past 24 hours, with ETH falling 1.08% to $1,848.49, reflecting broader market caution.
title: Ethereum at Critical Pivot Point as Market Shows Caution

details: The CLARITY Act, a significant piece of legislation aimed at establishing a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies in the United States, faces delays in the Senate. The bill is reportedly stalled due to unresolved issues, including ethics disputes and provisions related to stablecoins, with the approaching August recess adding pressure. In contrast, the GENIUS Act, focused on payment stablecoins, is seeing accelerated rulemaking, prompting banks to reassess their strategies and signaling a structural shift in the stablecoin market.
title: US Crypto Regulatory Progress Stalls on CLARITY Act, GENIUS Act Advances

details: Cross-chain bridge protocol Allbridge has temporarily halted its Core protocol following a flash loan attack that resulted in the loss of approximately $1.65 million from its Solana-based stablecoin liquidity pools. The attacker exploited the protocol's internal pricing logic to drain funds. This incident highlights ongoing security vulnerabilities in the DeFi space, which has seen over $840 million lost to hacks in the first five months of 2026.
title: Allbridge Suffers $1.65 Million Flash Loan Attack on Solana Pools

details: While overall crypto venture funding reached $1.2 billion in July, investment specifically into decentralized finance (DeFi) projects has experienced a downturn, marking its third consecutive quarterly decline. The latest quarterly funding for DeFi is the lowest recorded since the fourth quarter of 2023, with the number of deals reaching a low not seen since 2020. Other sectors like exchanges, prediction markets, payments, and artificial intelligence are currently attracting the majority of funding.
title: DeFi Venture Funding Declines to Lowest Quarterly Level Since Late 2023

details: The Ethereum Name Service (ENS) DAO has officially approved and activated a new eight-member Security Council. This council, established for a two-year term, possesses the authority to veto malicious governance proposals after they have been passed but before their execution. This new safeguard aims to mitigate risks associated with compromised or hastily decided governance actions, thereby bolstering the security and integrity of ENS governance during its timelock period.
title: Ethereum Name Service (ENS) Activates Security Council for Enhanced Governance

details: The total market capitalization of stablecoins on the Solana network surpassed $15 billion on July 20. A significant driver of this growth is the increasing diversification beyond USDC and USDT, with the combined supply of other stablecoins reaching a new all-time high of $4.81 billion. This surge is primarily led by USD1 and USDG, indicating growing institutional interest and broader adoption of stablecoin offerings within the Solana ecosystem.
title: Solana Stablecoin Market Cap Hits New All-Time High, Diversifies Beyond USDC/USDT
